title: Genesis 8:1-3 — God remembered Noah; the water decreased after 150 days
summary: Genesis 8:1-3 in English: God remembered Noah and those in the ark, sent a wind, closed the fountains of the deep and the floodgates of the sky, and after 150 days the water decreased. Letters are coloured: G blue, o red, d gold in 'God'; 'No' green in Noah; 'ar' red in ark; '150 days' is enlarged.

text.text: 1 But God remembered Noah and all the beasts and all the cattle that were with him in the ark; and God caused a wind to pass over the earth, and the water subsided.
2 Also the fountains of the deep and the floodgates of the sky were closed, and the rain from the sky was restrained;
3 and the water receded steadily from the earth, and at the end of 150 days the water decreased.

numbers.note: days at the end of which the water decreased
